newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat seaside hotels to be offered for sale-agency.
newsitem.headline: Croat seaside hotels to be offered for sale-agency.

text.p: Croatian hotelier Hoteli Makarska on southern Adriatic coast may offer four of its facilities for sale in 1997, news agency Hina reported on Friday.
It provided no prices, but said the hotel expected to attract most interest was Biokovo with 110 beds in town centre which was partly refurbished a year ago.
Makarska also plans to put to tender 140-bed beach hotel Park, used to shelter war refugees for the past five years, and Miramare and Osejava each with 80 beds.
Its remaining facilities, totalling roughly 1,500 beds, have already been contracted for next year's season by Croatian and foreign travel agents. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
